entities.summary: Ryan Patrick Kelly is an American former professional football player who was a center for 10 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, and was selected by the Indianapolis Colts in the first round of the 2016 NFL draft. He also played for the Minnesota Vikings.
